{{Spell InfoBox|image=Split.png|type=Spell Boost|rarity=Normal|mp_cost1=x150%|mp_cost2=x150%|mp_cost3=x150%|misc_a_1=Splits into 3 spells upon the completion of the spell, each dealing 33% damage|misc_a_2=Splits into 5 spells upon the completion of the spell, each dealing 33% damage|misc_a_3=Splits into 8 spells upon the completion of the spell, each dealing 33% damage}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Boost. It splits a single cast into multiple casts for a slight increase in MP Cost but a damage per spell decrease. The Mana Cost to damage ratio improves as the Spell Level increases.

When applied to passive spells like [[Bi'an Flying Sword]], [[Rune Hammer]] and [[Prism Core]] they be always in the split state, doing 33% of the original damage, which is especially detrimental for [[Bi'an Flying Sword]] which will not receive any extra copies.
